pov: you find the BEST Italian Bakery in Atlanta! 🥐 ☕️ 🇮🇹 

📌 SAVE this if you LOVE gorgeous cafes and pastries and SHARE with your group chat for the next spot for a coffee date in Atlanta!

There is a brand new Italian bakery in Atlanta and it’s going viral it’s incredible pastries. And we think, they have THE BEST pistachio croissant in Atlanta!

@rosettabakery just opened their second location in Atlanta at @highstreetatl and it’s absolutely stunning! We love walking into the store and seeing the line of yummy pastries and the bakers creating these delicious treats. From croissants, coffee and fruit tarts, to focaccia sandwiches and pizzas there are so many delicious options at @rosettabakery 

This location at @highstreetatl is perfect for grabbing a coffee date with friends, a space to work from and we love their large outdoor green space, that’s the ultimate spot for enjoying an Italian pastry!

📍 Rosetta Bakery - 120 High Street, Dunwoody, GA
🥐 Delicious Italian Bakery with pastries, pizzas & sandwiches
⏰ Open Daily from 8am - 5pm
🌲 Located at the fabulous @highstreetatl with outdoor space

FOLLOW @atlfoodiesofficial for all of the best places to eat in and around Atlanta!

#atlanta #atlantageorgia #atlantafood #atlantafoodie
text: Atlanta just got a new Italian bakery and it's already going viral for its delicious pastries. From the pistachio croissant to gorgeous fruit tart and focaccia sandwiches, Rosetta Bakery is selling out daily. You may know them from their popular Buckhead location, but we were so excited to hear about the opening at High Street in Dunwoody. It's the perfect place to grab a coffee with friends, work from, and enjoy the gorgeous outdoor green space with an Italian pastry.
